title: docsrs-cli get-item success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command get-item. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms. Optional fields are omitted when absent (never JSON null).

resolved_version.description: Omitted when docs.rs did not resolve a concrete version (never JSON null)

cache_hit.description: True when the HTTP response body was served from the local disk cache

extraction.description: Present for associated-member success: always method when the anchor was found (1.2.0+ fail-closed). Read it as 'the markdown came from the member anchor', NOT as 'the member is a function' — it reports method for variant. and structfield. anchors too. Use anchor_family for the real family. item_page is legacy and MUST NOT appear on success — missing anchors return not_found exit 66. Omitted for non-member items.

anchor_family.description: Rustdoc anchor family the markdown was scoped to, derived from the anchor id that matched on the page. Added in 2.0.0 alongside the unchanged extraction field, because agents already assert extraction == "method" to reject a parent-page false success. Omitted for non-member items (never JSON null).

resolved_item_path.description: Canonical rustdoc path when a root/reexport path was resolved via all.html. Omitted when the requested path was used as-is (never JSON null).
